description: This file defines the 'DB' class within the Opencart	he System	he Library namespace. It encapsulates database operations such as executing queries, escaping values, and retrieving metadata like last inserted ID and affected rows. The class acts as an adapter, dynamically loading specific database driver classes based on the given adaptor type, and provides an interface for database interactions in the OpenCart platform.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: A database abstraction class that loads specific database adaptors based on configuration and provides methods for executing queries, escaping data, and retrieving database info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DB object by loading the specified database adaptor class with connection parameters.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement using the underlying adaptor.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string value to be safe for SQL queries, preventing injections.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query executed.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from the database.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the current database connection is active.
